column1: # The median seconds per step and OS of the last three check-core runs on main (#373): the baseline scripts/ci-times
# reads with --baseline (a step over max(floor(b * 1.3), b + 60) is a warning in the check-<os> jobs). Raised only by a
# pull request's own diff: scripts/ci-times on three main runs, then the new medians here. Runs: 41584645981 (a4e608f),
# 41555979259 (b5f0a28), 41457590582 (14eba92), all before the shards: the steps' shape changes the seconds.
# The compaction rows (#342) are provisional: one run of their own pull request (41633875397), not three medians of main.
